run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-18T00:43:03Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert for otel-demo/frontend is backed by a real, time-bounded burst of frontend error spans: the frontend error-span rate was 0 until 00:42, peaked at ~3.98 spans/s around 00:47 and was back to 0 by 00:54 (b8848311-9bc9-4810-a04a-e6b8b738b097-t1:b9cffe80-446f-4e2e-8f95-1d8dd2efc892). The observed failures are transport-level, not application-level: frontend's grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds span failed with '14 UNAVAILABLE ... connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080' and its grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder span failed with '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused' (75f3a020-4dd9-4e76-a08c-c59937de5aed-t0:efe92751-9cf9-452b-aa99-ce23a7d5706e); those two IPs are exactly the ClusterIPs of the ad and payment Services (489c7df2-0823-49ef-81cd-a62bc88e67db-t1:2df8cec5-5df3-4f43-a31e-0f3f18dccd15). Both Deployments ad and payment were rolled out at 2026-11-18T00:41:29Z: new ReplicaSets, new pods started, old single pods killed at 00:41:32/00:41:33, same image tags already present (f013a5a1-06d0-4b2c-bdf4-c2b7905b0724-t0:da169583-7f41-42ce-985f-64cee0d3376a). The pod template delta is only spec.template.metadata.annotations kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:41:29Z; image, env, ports and resources are identical in revision 1 and revision 2 ReplicaSets (34cba365-9bc6-498a-8601-7a4dab84136a-t0:9a07fd8b-3462-42a9-ba98-f58235c5463e; e8d0ad5b-cb7d-4efc-b4b5-fe96c57e2505-t0:c91f3f92-a6c0-4cc0-b72a-52191f358319). ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config currently holds two switched-on fault-injection settings whose descriptions name exactly those two services: adFailure defaultVariant 'on' ('Fail ad service') and paymentFailure defaultVariant '100%' ('Fail payment service charge requests n%'); the setting that would declare payment unavailable (paymentUnreachable) is off (b9d13f68-8a66-4639-bb58-91cd647afd94-t0:da564c15-9b22-450a-bcb7-9ab565691083). Following the fault-setting rule I name that ConfigMap as the root-cause object, with the 00:41:29Z rollout restart as the mechanism and the frontend 500s as the consequence, but the conclusion is partial: the declared faults themselves (ad returning failures, charges being declined) were never observed, the failures were connection refusals, payment completed charges and ad served ads normally at ~00:50 while the flags still read 'on' (b920b229-f8dd-4b4e-b027-b841ec3b2c57-t2:277e5d31-ce48-4b87-a2c2-282266cd0106; eb75f6b7-e0f8-4ba8-b29e-9490d04e9e17-t0:dee01937-54e3-47f5-938b-6bd7b4f22953), and it cannot be determined when the flag values were set or who/what issued the restarts (change history not integrated). An alternative, evidence-consistent mechanism remains open: the rolling restart removed the only serving replica of two probe-less Deployments (ad CPU limit 50m, payment 20m), leaving the Services without a listening backend for ~8 and ~6 minutes (dab77082-a614-43d2-8dcb-a9c20d15c3f5-t1:af5a5b27-554b-49c0-953c-d970ca0a0d32).

claims.text: Frontend error-span rate (traces_span_metrics_calls_total status_code=STATUS_CODE_ERROR) was 0 through 00:42, rose to 0.337 at 00:43, peaked at 3.9778 at 00:47, declined to 0.6222 at 00:53 and was 0 at 00:54 — matching the alert that opened at 00:43:03Z.

The frontend operations carrying ERROR spans in the same window were GET, GET /api/data, POST, POST /api/checkout, grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds, grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder and tcp.connect; all of them were 0 before the 00:44 bucket.

Span error details at 00:42:37Z: frontend grpc.oteldemo.AdService/GetAds failed with '14 UNAVAILABLE: No connection established. Last error: connect ECONNREFUSED 100.65.180.246:8080', and frontend grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder failed with '13 INTERNAL: failed to charge card ... rpc error: code = Unavailable ... dial tcp 100.70.188.60:8080: connect: connection refused'.

100.65.180.246 is the ClusterIP of Service otel-demo/ad and 100.70.188.60 is the ClusterIP of Service otel-demo/payment (both port 8080 -> targetPort 8080); the current ad and payment pod IPs are 100.96.x, so the refusals came from the Service VIPs rather than a pod IP.

Deployment ad and Deployment payment were rolled out at 00:41:29Z (new ReplicaSets ad-6cb57f76d, payment-9c8ffb665; new pods Scheduled 00:41:29, Started 00:41:31-32, old pods ad-554b849958-mbnxm and payment-55766d76b9-c4wgb Stopping/Killed 00:41:32 and 00:41:33, image 'already present on machine').

Deployments ad and payment carry spec.template.metadata.annotations kubectl.kubernetes.io/restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:41:29Z and deployment.kubernetes.io/revision=2; the previous ReplicaSet of each workload is at revision 1, created 00:07:44-45Z.

Revision 1 and revision 2 ReplicaSets of both ad and payment have identical container definitions (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-ad / :2.1.3-payment, identical env, containerPort 8080, identical CPU/memory requests and limits), so the only visible pod-template change behind revision 2 is the restartedAt annotation.

Deployments ad and payment define no readinessProbe, livenessProbe or startupProbe; ad's container limit is cpu 50m (request 10m) and payment's is cpu 20m (request 10m), with RollingUpdate maxSurge 25% / maxUnavailable 25%.

During the same window the ad service's traced span rate fell from ~1.6 spans/s to 0.308 by 00:46 and was 0 for the buckets ending 00:47 through 00:51, then recovered to 0.696 at 00:52 and ~1.03-1.06 by 00:53-00:54; payment's span rate dipped from ~1.2/s to 0.49 at 00:45 and recovered to ~1.08 by 00:49; frontend's overall span rate stayed ~43-45 spans/s.
ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config (key demo.flagd.json) currently declares flag adFailure with defaultVariant 'on', description 'Fail ad service', state ENABLED.
The same ConfigMap declares flag paymentFailure with defaultVariant '100%', description 'Fail payment service charge requests n%', state ENABLED.

The same ConfigMap declares paymentUnreachable ('Payment service is unavailable') as 'off', and adHighCpu, adManualGc, cartFailure, emailMemoryLeak, imageSlowLoad, kafkaQueueProblems, loadGeneratorFloodHomepage, productCatalogFailure and recommendationCacheFailure also as 'off'.

Entities with their own error evidence during the window: frontend (ERROR spans on GET /api/data and POST /api/checkout with http.status_code 500), frontend-proxy (ERROR spans on 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' with http.status_code 500 in the same traces), checkout (ERROR span oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder rpc.grpc.status_code 13 and its client span oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge rpc.grpc.status_code 14 'connection refused' to 100.70.188.60:8080), and load-generator (ERROR spans GET/POST http.status_code 500).

Per-service error-span rate over time: frontend rose from 0 to 2.745/3.978/3.007/2.007 and back to 0.622/0, frontend-proxy rose from 0.0074 to 1.363/2.007/1.533/1.011 and back to 0.311/0, checkout showed 0.275 (00:45) and 0.244 (00:47) then 0; accounting, ad, cart and payment were 0 throughout, fraud-detection and recommendation stayed at background ~0.0037.

ad and payment recorded essentially no ERROR spans of their own (ad's ERROR rate was 0 except a single 0.0111 blip at the 00:35 bucket; payment's ERROR rate was 0 for GET, dns.lookup and tcp.connect across the window), even while their callers received connection refused.

Recovery state: all 21 otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState; ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84 have startTime 2026-11-18T00:41:29Z, and the ad and payment Endpoints now list those pods (100.96.4.142:8080 and 100.96.4.221:8080).

ad pod logs 00:50:25-00:50:55Z show normal handling ('Targeted ad request received for [books]', 'Non-targeted ad request received, preparing random response.'), and payment pod logs 00:50:43-00:50:58Z show 'Charge request received.' immediately followed by 'Transaction complete.'

ConfigMap otel-demo/flagd-config holds the two enabled fault-injection settings (adFailure=on, paymentFailure=100%) whose descriptions name ad and payment — the exact two Deployments restarted at 00:41:29Z with an unchanged container spec and the two Services whose ClusterIPs refused connections — so the fault held in that ConfigMap is the leading candidate root cause, with the restartedAt rollout as the mechanism and the frontend 500s as the consequence.

Alternative mechanism not excluded by the evidence: the rollout restart itself removed the only serving replica of ad and payment; because neither Deployment has a readinessProbe and the containers run with very low CPU limits (ad 50m, payment 20m), the replacement pods were marked Ready on container start but were not yet listening on 8080, so the Service VIPs refused connections for several minutes until the applications came up.

The declared faults were not observed as such: the observed failures are TCP connection refusals at the Service VIPs, not ad returning INTERNAL errors or payment declining charges; ad served normal ad responses and payment completed charges at ~00:50 while adFailure='on' and paymentFailure='100%' were read.

The flag that would declare payment unreachable (paymentUnreachable, description 'Payment service is unavailable') is 'off', yet payment was in fact unreachable from checkout at 00:42:37Z; and ad/payment themselves emitted essentially no ERROR spans, so the unavailability is not an application-level fault reported by those services.

The two ReplicaSet revisions of ad and payment differ only by the restartedAt annotation; image, env, ports and resource limits are identical, so no container-level configuration change accompanies the restart that could itself explain the outage.

Rejected: pod crash, OOMKill or eviction as the cause. All otel-demo pods are Running and Ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState for ad-6cb57f76d-xmcq6 and payment-9c8ffb665-qrm84, and the only otel-demo events in the window are the rollout's Normal Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started/Killing/SuccessfulCreate/SuccessfulDelete — no OOMKilled, Evicted or Unhealthy events.

Review who or what issued the kubectl rollout restart recorded as restartedAt=2026-11-18T00:41:29Z on Deployments ad and payment, and reset/re-verify the flagd flags adFailure and paymentFailure with the flag owner (the change-history integration needed for this is not available in this Run).

Add readiness probes to the ad and payment containers and raise their very low CPU limits (50m and 20m) so that a single-replica rolling restart cannot leave the Services without a listening backend for minutes.

gaps: Change history is not integrated in this Run (not_integrated: change_history), so what or who triggered the rollout restart of Deployments ad and payment at 2026-11-18T00:41:29Z is unknown.
It cannot be determined when the flagd-config values adFailure='on' and paymentFailure='100%' were set: the ConfigMap was read as current state at ~01:00Z, not as incident-time state.

No kube-state-metrics series were returned for this target (queries for kube_deployment_status_replicas_ready and {__name__=~"kube_.*"} matched nothing), so the ready-replica and pod-condition timeline between 00:41 and 00:51Z is unobserved.

Jaeger data available in this Run ended at 00:42:37Z, so the error type behind the remainder of the frontend error-rate spike (buckets 00:43-00:53) is unknown; only the metric series covers that period.
Pod log retention starts at 00:50:25Z (ad) and 00:50:43Z (payment) and the deleted pods' logs are gone, so the startup behaviour of the replacement pods between 00:41:31 and ~00:50Z is unknown.
The trace views are biased projections of sampled traces: span counts are not unique request counts and the presented spans are not the complete call graph.
